### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **3** package(s): `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`, `@objectstack/rest`, `@objectstack/types`, touching **8** documentable anchor(s).

**16** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 5b1fe45fb8dbc6ef664933eb28823d556b71aac7`.

⛔ **5** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- the SDK route bridge reached **65** of **247** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **182** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **182**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **123** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **34** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 5b1fe45fb8dbc6ef664933eb28823d556b71aac7` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `932422c7c52824e43d1959f2fcb369778a38b863` — the merge of head `264f8f3da019ba6497acb29f3925093ecdd84ccd` into base `5b1fe45fb8dbc6ef664933eb28823d556b71aac7`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 932422c7c52824e43d1959f2fcb369778a38b863 && git checkout 932422c7c52824e43d1959f2fcb369778a38b863
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 5b1fe45fb8dbc6ef664933eb28823d556b71aac7 264f8f3da019ba6497acb29f3925093ecdd84ccd && git checkout -B drift-repro 5b1fe45fb8dbc6ef664933eb28823d556b71aac7 && git merge --no-ff 264f8f3da019ba6497acb29f3925093ecdd84ccd

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 5b1fe45fb8dbc6ef664933eb28823d556b71aac7
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 5b1fe45fb8dbc6ef664933eb28823d556b71aac7` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `41354c38a3749699078820f329ab9b11fdb8c8f4`
Local-runs: probe — the brief ordered the touched packages' tests and one ablation of the central carry (resolver `details.candidates`), run in a detached worktree at this head; nothing pushed
Scope: declaration face, whole diff `origin/main...41354c38a` (merge base `cbf6956fe`, 11 files, +540 / -24): `packages/types/src/thrown-http-error.ts`, `packages/types/src/data-error-classification.ts`, `packages/rest/src/error-response.ts`, `packages/rest/src/batch-routes.ts`, `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-client-failures.ts`, the five test files, the changeset + read only, outside the diff: `packages/core/src/package-scoped-resolution.ts`, `packages/types/src/actions-door-answer.ts`, `packages/runtime/src/http-dispatcher.ts`, `packages/spec/src/api/contract.zod.ts`, `packages/spec/src/api/errors.zod.ts`, `packages/client/src/index.ts`

Tier: the committed tree touches no `packages/spec/src/**` file and no governed path; `record-recognisers.mjs --paths` reads no face off the paths and hands the decision to the changeset's `Clause-②: yes (widening)` line, which is the declaration face. Round 1 on this head. Card #32250, claim 6817626155, ruling 6817764528 (F1 = A, F2 = A), os-dev-report 6825038590 read.

### ① Derived judgments

Every FROM → TO row of the PR body, read against the code at this head:

- `POST /data/:object`, `PATCH`, `DELETE /data/:object/:id` (`mapDataError`): TRUE. `classifyDataError`'s declared-status passthrough appends `details: { candidates }` after `object`; `error`, `code`, `object` and the status are the same expressions as on `main`. Pinned by `toEqual` on the whole body over the real routes, for the class and for the plain shape.
- `POST /data/:object/createMany`: TRUE. `handleRouteError` now receives `{ packageScopedCandidates: true }`; the class declares `status: 409`, so it leaves through the passthrough arm, where `packageScopedCandidatesMember` is the last key. Pinned.
- Cross-object `POST /batch`: the option is passed at the catch; FROM and TO are declared NOT MEASURED and no pin covers the line (finding N1). The exit is the same `handleRouteError` arm the `createMany` pin runs.
- Per-row doors (`updateMany`, `deleteMany`, `/:object/batch` create, update, upsert, upsert atomic, delete): TRUE. `toRowApiError` adds `details: { candidates }` after `httpStatus`; `code`, `message`, `httpStatus` unmoved. Pinned by `toEqual` on the whole `results` array, 7 doors by 2 throw kinds. `ApiError.details` is `z.unknown().optional()` in the spec, so no schema moves.
- Dispatcher `/data` on `@objectstack/hono` (`declaredEnvelopeForThrow`): TRUE, pinned by `toEqual` on the envelope, with a no-refusal control.
- Dispatcher `GET /meta/:type/:name/layers`: TRUE, pinned (two holders) with a one-holder control.
- Dispatcher bare `GET /meta/action/:name/layers` and `/published` (#32365, from `main`): TRUE, and verified specifically. On `main` the #32365 describe asserted `details.candidates` on the item read only and its comment said the other two doors carry text only; at this head the assertion sits inside the `for (const door of DOORS)` loop over `/action/approve`, `/action/approve/layers` and `/action/approve/published`, in both cases (`[pkg(A), platform]` and `[pkg(A), pkg(B), platform]`), and the comment is corrected. The list is the refusal's own, verbatim, so the three doors answer one shape, `{ kind: 'platform' }` included. Under the ablation below both cases go red.

Shape across doors: one recogniser (`packageScopedRefusalCandidates`, `@objectstack/types`) feeds the resolver, `mapDataError`, `toRowApiError` and rest's `/meta` reader; each passes `refusal.candidates` through unmapped. REST flat bodies carry it at `details.candidates`, envelope doors at `error.details.candidates`, rows at `errors[0].details.candidates`, as declared.

Nothing else moves on the wire: status, `code`, `error`/`message`, `object`, `httpStatus` are unchanged expressions; the member is appended last in each body. Controls pinned: `UNIQUE_VIOLATION` (whole-request and row), `CONCURRENT_UPDATE` (key set), a `RESOURCE_CONFLICT` with no refusal (whole-request, row, hono, resolver), a non-refused `refusal`, a non-list `candidates`, the refused shape under another code. No new disclosure: the refusal's message already names every candidate (`packageScopedRefusalMessage`).

Rest's recogniser dropped its `instanceof` limb for the shared shape read. Equivalent for the class (its `code` is the literal `RESOURCE_CONFLICT`, its `refusal.status` the literal `refused`); the `/meta` pins from #32201 stay green in the full rest run.

Local runs at this head (worktree, deps built with `OS_SKIP_DTS=1`):

- `@objectstack/types` full: 40 files, 892 passed.
- `@objectstack/hono` full: 14 files, 236 passed.
- `@objectstack/rest` full: 412 files, 8272 passed, 355 skipped.
- `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` full: 344 files (337 passed, 7 skipped), 22763 passed, 36 skipped.
- `@objectstack/runtime`: `meta-qualified-item-read.test.ts` and `action-dispatch.test.ts` only, 79 passed. The full runtime suite was NOT run (budget).
- Ablation, the resolver's `...(candidates ? { candidates } : {})` line removed, types `dist` rebuilt with the marker confirmed present: types resolver cases 3 red; hono twin 1 red; runtime `meta-qualified-item-read` 3 red (the `/layers` pin and both #32365 action-door cases); rest's 26 pins stay green, as they should (they ride `mapDataError`, the route option and `toRowApiError`, the PR's A2 to A4, not repeated here). Restored with `git checkout`, `dist` rebuilt, marker absent, runtime file back to 47 passed.
- Not run: typecheck, lint, the gate roster, dogfood, the A2 to A4 ablations, plugin-hono-server. CI check-runs on this head when read: 54 success, 13 skipped, 2 in progress, none failed.

### ② Semver level

`patch` on `@objectstack/types`, `@objectstack/rest`, `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` with `Metadata-protocol: none`: correct under the AGENTS.md rule (the level follows the metadata-protocol kind alone; a non-protocol widening ships `patch`). Nothing a metadata author can write changes. The types change is additive: one new export (`packageScopedRefusalCandidates`, reached through `export *` in `index.ts`), one new optional member inside the already-open `details: Record`; no export removed or retyped. `Clause-②: yes (widening)` is present, line-initial, in both the PR body and the changeset. No `packages/spec` change is needed and none is made.

### ③ Boundary flags

- PR author login is `objectstack-fleet[bot]`; nothing to name.
- File surface: `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-client-failures.ts` is outside the claim's surface and inside the amendment's (6817764528, F2 = A). `packages/runtime` and `packages/adapters/hono` are touched in tests only, which the ruling's F1 pins ask for.
- ADR-0150 D5 (every ambiguous by-name answer names its candidates): the diff moves toward it; no door picks a holder, no refusal is softened, no status or code moves. No red-line issue found.
- Security: none found.

Findings:

- **S1 (should-fix, prose plus one comment; no wire change).** Through `@objectstack/client` the flat `/data` answer's `err.details` moves for this one refusal. `packages/client/src/index.ts` sets `error.details = errorBody?.details ?? errorBody?.error?.details ?? errorBody`, and its comment says the flat envelope has no top-level `details`, so it falls through to the whole body. With this PR the single-record and `createMany` 409 carries a top-level `details`, so an SDK caller's `err.details` goes from the whole body (`error`, `code`, `object`) to `{ candidates }`; `err.code`, `err.message` and `err.httpStatus` are unmoved. Read in the code, not run. The `/meta` flat door has done the same since #32201 and the client's own jsdoc already teaches `err.details.candidates`, so this is the established reading, but the PR body and changeset declare the wire only. Name this SDK-visible move in both (FROM `err.details` = whole body, TO `{ candidates }`, for this refusal on the flat `/data` doors), and correct the stale client comment in a follow-up if `packages/client` is outside this card's surface.
- **N1 (nit, follow-up card).** The cross-object `POST /batch` line is changed and unpinned; a mocked-protocol pin of that catch would close the NOT MEASURED row.
- **N2 (nit).** `handleRouteError` callers that do not pass the option still answer this refusal without candidates when it declares `status`, but gain them when it declares only `statusCode` (that spelling falls to `mapDataError`, which now always adds the member). The `RouteErrorOptions` jsdoc line "Every other route's answer is unchanged" is not exact in that corner. Additive either way; the remaining non-opted rest routes are D5 residue for a follow-up card.
- **N3 (nit).** `thrownAnswerOf`'s jsdoc in `actions-door-answer.ts` still lists the resolver's `details` as `issues`, `fields`, a non-string `code`; `candidates` is now a fourth.
- **N4 (nit).** The changeset and the recogniser's jsdoc spell the shape as `[{ kind: 'package', packageId }, …]`; the list is `PackageScopedHolder[]` verbatim and can hold `{ kind: 'platform' }`, `{ kind: 'environment' }` and `{ kind: 'residual', ownerId }`, as the PR body's action row and the #32365 pin show.
- **N5 (nit).** The PR body's counts for this head (types 39 files / 881; rest 407 files / 7972) did not reproduce here: 40 / 892 and 412 / 8272 by `vitest run` in each package. Both green; the figures match the body's earlier `2abf1d1d95` readings more closely than its own for this head.
- **N6 (nit).** The errorFromThrown census is by category. `PackageScopedNameRefusedError` is thrown from many producers (metadata store, registry, automation engine, analytics, action execution), so more dispatcher doors than the three tabled gain the member; the changeset's "every door that answers from it" covers them, and the ruling asked for the remaining doors named, unpinned.

PASS with one should-fix (S1, prose-face declaration) and six nits (N1 to N6); no must-fix.
